record.original_question: Let C₄ denote the 4-cycle, and let f(n; C₄) be the number of labeled graphs on n vertices that do not contain C₄ as a subgraph. Determine the asymptotic growth of f(n; C₄), in particular whether f(n; C₄) = 2^(1/2+o(1)) n^(3/2) as suggested in the source.

evidence.quote: Kleitman and Winston [3] proved f(n; C₄) < 2^cn^(3/2). As far as I know f(n; C₄) = 2^(1/2+o(1))n^(3/2) is still open.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C_4$ denote the cycle on $4$ vertices. For a positive integer $n$, let $f(n; C_4)$ denote the number of labeled simple graphs on the vertex set $\{1, 2, \ldots, n\}$ that contain no copy of $C_4$ as a (not necessarily induced) subgraph. It is known that there exists a constant $c > 0$ such that $f(n; C_4) \le 2^{c n^{3/2}}$ for all sufficiently large $n$. Determine the precise asymptotic growth of $\log_2 f(n; C_4)$. In particular, decide whether
$$ f(n; C_4) = 2^{\left(\tfrac{1}{2} + o(1)\right) n^{3/2}} \quad \text{as } n \to \infty, $$
i.e. whether $\lim_{n\to\infty} \frac{\log_2 f(n; C_4)}{n^{3/2}} = \tfrac{1}{2}$.
artifact.status_search_result: The classical Kleitman–Winston bound (1982) shows $f(n;C_4) = 2^{O(n^{3/2})}$, matching $\mathrm{ex}(n,C_4) = \Theta(n^{3/2})$. Subsequent works (e.g., Kleitman–Wilson and Balogh–Samotij on $K_{m,m}$-free counts; the SIAM J. Discrete Math. paper showing almost all $C_4$-free graphs have fewer than $(1-\varepsilon)\,\mathrm{ex}(n,C_4)$ edges) refine related structural and edge-density questions, but the precise asymptotic constant $\tfrac{1}{2}$ in the exponent appears not to be established. Surveys of forbidden-subgraph enumeration list this as still open for bipartite forbidden graphs including $C_4$.

status_evidence.title: On the number of graphs without 4-cycles (Kleitman–Winston)
status_evidence.snippet: Kleitman and Winston established f(n; C_4) = 2^{O(n^{3/2})}.
status_evidence.claim: Upper bound 2^{cn^{3/2}} is known; precise constant not pinned down.

status_evidence.title: Number of graphs with a forbidden subgraph (Erdős problems)
status_evidence.snippet: For bipartite H the correct order of log_2 f_n(H) is not known; open even for H = C_4.

status_evidence.title: Almost all C_4-free graphs have fewer than (1−ε) ex(n,C_4) edges
status_evidence.snippet: Structural result on typical C_4-free graphs but does not pin down the constant 1/2 in the exponent.
status_evidence.claim: Related partial progress, asymptotic constant still not determined.
